description: Source code for a report designer module in an OpenERP/Odoo project, including class and method definitions for report processing and conversion.

classes.name: report_xml
classes.description: A class extending 'ir.actions.report.xml' with methods for converting SXW files to RML, uploading reports, and retrieving report content.

methods.name: sxwtorml
methods.description: Converts an SXW file to RML format using an XSL transformation.

methods.name: upload_report
methods.description: Uploads and saves a report with SXW content, converting it to RML, and registering the report.

methods.name: report_get
methods.description: Retrieves report content, encoding it in base64 for transfer.
